text_block_list.text:
"I haven't had any time to clean up the 
Trainer's office lately. Today, while 
chasing after urgent tasks right in front 
of me—"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. About that book you let me read 
the other day... Could I borrow it...?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...Well now. Looks like you're having a 
tough time searching right now.
choice_data_list:
Sorry for the mess. I've been so busy 
lately...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Don't pay it no mind. It's not an urgent 
matter, after all.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: More importantly... ......

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
The boxes and feather dusters were over 
that way, right?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"I'll tidy this up, so please go ahead and 
continue with your work."
choice_data_list: Oh, I'd feel bad accepting that.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Please don't hold back. Right now, I think 
it's best if you can fully focus, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Phew. That's the last of the big stuff, 
then.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Let's wrap up the fine details, and once 
that's done, we can dust everything off.
choice_data_list: You're pretty skillful with your hands.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Well, I'm just used to it.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Back home, my little brother and sister 
were always running all over the place, so 
I got used to cleaning up right alongside 
'em.

text_block_list.name: Lara's Younger Siblings
text_block_list.text:
—Whoa! The comedy show's startin' soon! 
—Where're the snacks? Over here maybe?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I'm mopping the floor right there. If 
you're heading to the TV, go around by the 
veranda.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"I've left some snacks on the desk, so 
grab some from there. I'm cleaning the 
kitchen right now, so please don't come 
in~."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
—It was total chaos, really. If you don't 
do it briskly, you'll never get it done.
choice_data_list: You were being such a good big sister.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Do you think so? Ufufu. It's just that at 
our house, things wouldn't run otherwise.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Whoops, since we're here anyway, let's not 
just flap our gums—let's get our hands 
moving together.

As if eased by the calm atmosphere of the 
tidy room, my unnecessary tension melted 
away. Before I knew it, work progressed 
faster than scheduled—
choice_data_list: Phew~~

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my... Your expression has softened a 
bit.
choice_data_list:
Yeah, I guess we've finally reached a good 
stopping point.

Yeah, looks like things have finally 
settled down.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I see. We've just caught our breath over 
here as well.
choice_data_list:
In that case, why don't we step out for a 
short break?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Sounds good. In that case... there's a 
shop I've been curious about for a while.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Look, right here. I saw it in a magazine 
and kind of remembered it.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
It's close to the academy, and the vibe 
seems real calm, too. Thought it'd be a 
nice spot to relax.
choice_data_list: Yeah, looks like we can take it easy.
Yeah, looks like we can take it easy.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. Well then, shall we dig in 
together?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Phew... That really hits the spot.
choice_data_list: Yeah, this is delicious. ...
Yeah, it's delicious. ...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...Oh. You seem a bit spaced out, don't 
you?
choice_data_list:
...Yeah. My head's still feeling a bit 
foggy.

...Yeah. My head still feels a bit cloudy 
and tired.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I suppose so. Considering how hard you've 
worked to get here.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"...Come to think of it, when we were 
little, my little sister used to say: 
'Boba is just so cute~♡'"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Well, he does look pretty round, doesn't 
he? Just watchin' him relax warmly in the 
hot spring is so soothin' to me~..."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, that's a capybara, not tapioca! 
They sound kinda similar, but still!
choice_data_list: —Pfft! What is that... Haha.
—Pfft! What is that... Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Ah, you smiled.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu♪ ...Did that help you relax your 
shoulders a bit?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Workin' hard is all well and good, but 
make sure ya don't overdo it, alright?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Having Trainer stay healthy and well is 
the most important thing to me.
choice_data_list:
Yeah. I'll be careful and keep working 
through the rest

Yeah. I'll be careful and do my best with 
the rest of the work.

Well then, as thanks—Special Move: Comic 
Comeback!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Having Trainer stay healthy and well is 
the most important thing to me.
choice_data_list:
Yeah. I'll be careful and keep working 
through the rest

Yeah. I'll be careful and do my best with 
the rest of the work.

Well then, as thanks—Special Move: Comic 
Comeback!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. All right then. Shall we take it 
easy for just a little longer?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Gotta make sure we build up our energy. 
...Right?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Returning the punchline...? Wait, what am 
I supposed to return?
choice_data_list: I'll think about that now.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Wait, so ya didn't think about it at all?!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: —Pfft. Ahaha...!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Ah...... Man, that really takes the wind 
out of your sails.
